Use case: scientific-educational. Create a realistic studio macro photograph of an unmistakable SINGLE DOVETAIL woodworking joint shown disassembled, viewed almost directly from above so the trapezoidal geometry is obvious. LEFT BOARD: a single dovetail tongue protruding from the end, shaped like a broad trapezoid, VERY NARROW at the neck where it meets the board (20mm) and VERY WIDE at the free outer end (40mm), with two clearly visible sloping sides; shaped like a flared fan, not rectangular. Clear wood grain, sharply cut angled side walls, realistic depth and shadows. Whole joint visible. No box joint, no square fingers, no mortise and tenon, no text or arrows or logos. Landscape 3:2 educational photograph, large simple subject against uncluttered background.
